lines.zh: 我沿着树枝跑，尾巴翘得高高的。
lines.en: I race along the branch, tail held high.

lines.zh: 我一跳，落到另一根枝条上。
lines.en: One leap carries me to the next branch.

lines.zh: 爪子抓住树皮，我往上爬。
lines.en: My claws grip the bark and I climb.
I come down the trunk headfirst.

lines.zh: 我贴着墙往上走，一点不滑。
lines.en: I climb the wall without slipping once.
Three hops, a pause, then three more.
Grass seeds have stuck to my tail.

lines.zh: 我钻过篱笆，尾巴最后过去。
lines.en: I slip the fence, tail bringing up the rear.

lines.zh: 我在地上小跑，随时准备上树。
lines.en: I trot on the ground, ready for a tree.
My paw prints are small and close together.
I step on dry leaves and they crackle.

lines.zh: 我沿着屋檐跑，很快就过去了。
lines.en: I run the roof edge and I am gone.
I hold a hazelnut and nibble slowly.

lines.zh: 尾巴一卷，盖在身上当被子。
lines.en: My tail curls over me like a blanket.
I stuff both cheeks until they bulge.
I sit up and look all around.
I wipe my face with my paws.

lines.zh: 我啃着树皮，苦得皱起脸。
lines.en: I gnaw the bark and my face screws up.

lines.zh: 我把榛子藏进树皮的缝里。
lines.en: I tuck a hazelnut into a bark crevice.
I count the people passing under my tree.

lines.zh: 有片叶子落下来，我盯着。
lines.en: A leaf falls and I watch it go.
I twitch my ears to shake off dust.
I hiccup softly and cover my mouth.

lines.zh: 这根树枝被我磨得发亮。
lines.en: I have worn this branch smooth.

lines.zh: 我抱着尾巴，闭眼歇一会。
lines.en: I hug my tail and rest my eyes.
It is quiet below, and I am in no hurry.

lines.zh: 我把榛子埋在树下，忘了位置。
lines.en: I bury a hazelnut and forget where.

lines.zh: 爪子擦过耳朵，痒得我一抖。
lines.en: My paw brushes my ear and I twitch.

lines.zh: 树影往东挪，我也跟着挪。
lines.en: The shade moves east, so I move with it.

lines.zh: 我试着把树苗立起来，立不住。
lines.en: I try to stand a sapling up and it will not hold.
You look up at me; I look back.
Do you have hazelnuts in that hand?
I cling to my branch and tilt my head.
You stand too close; I will bolt.

lines.zh: 你的帽子像一颗大坚果。
lines.en: Your hat looks like a giant nut.

lines.zh: 你的脚步一响，我就抬头。
lines.en: The moment your steps sound, I look up.

lines.zh: 我眨眨眼，尾巴轻轻一抖。
lines.en: I blink and give my tail a flick.
You reach out; I slip behind the branch.
Have you come here to plant trees?

lines.zh: 你的口袋鼓着，我盯了半天。
lines.en: Your pocket bulges and I stare at it.
Hold still; I have not decided to trust you.
The tree is safe; I will watch from here.

lines.zh: 你的目光追着我，我挪了挪。
lines.en: Your gaze follows me, so I shuffle aside.

lines.zh: 我小声叫了一下，算是招呼。
lines.en: I chirp once, which counts as a greeting.
You say nothing, and I stay up here.

lines.zh: 我爬到高处，才敢看你的脸。
lines.en: I climb high before daring to look at your face.
Someone stepped on my paw.
It hurts; I curl up around my tail.

lines.zh: 我从枝上滑下去，摔在草里。
lines.en: I slip off the branch and hit the grass.
My ears are pressed flat to my head.
That blow has ruffled all my fur.
I retreat into the hollow and shiver.
I can still climb, only slower now.

lines.zh: 别打了，我马上爬回树上。
lines.en: Stop hitting me; I am climbing back up.
Blood is smeared on the hazelnut shell.
I know exactly who struck me.

lines.zh: 榛子的味道，我一下就闻到。
lines.en: I catch the smell of hazelnuts at once.

lines.zh: 你把榛子放地上，我下来。
lines.en: Set the hazelnut down and I will come.

lines.zh: 我吸了吸鼻子，又靠近一点。
lines.en: I sniff, then edge a little closer.

lines.zh: 这颗榛子，够我藏一整冬。
lines.en: This nut could last me a whole winter.
I reach out, then pull my paw back.
Give it to me and I am yours.
I hug it and race up the branch.
Your hand wobbles and I miss the grab.
There is still room in my cheeks.
One more and I will stay right here.

lines.zh: 你碰了我，我一下就窜上树。
lines.en: You touch me and I shoot up the tree.
The bump knocks me into the grass.

lines.zh: 我抱着你的鞋，抬头看你。
lines.en: I cling to your shoe and look up.

lines.zh: 松鼠这么小，你差点踩到。
lines.en: I am small; you nearly stepped on me.
I leap right over your shoulder.
Do not push; my claws are not set.

lines.zh: 我踩过你的鞋面，窜上肩膀。
lines.en: I run over your shoe and up your shoulder.

lines.zh: 撞一下，我尾巴毛都炸了。
lines.en: One bump and my tail fluffs out.
I hop two steps off, then look back.
Pardon me; I am heading up the tree.
I offer her my largest hazelnut.

lines.zh: 我们在树枝上追来追去。
lines.en: We chase each other along the branches.
She grooms and I keep watch close by.

lines.zh: 我们一起把窝垫得更软。
lines.en: Together we make the nest softer.
Her tail is even fluffier than mine.

lines.zh: 我领她去看我藏榛子的地方。
lines.en: I show her where I hide my nuts.

lines.zh: 她的叫声很细，我应了一声。
lines.en: Her call is thin, so I answer softly.

lines.zh: 冬天我们挤在一个窝里。
lines.en: In winter we share a single nest.

lines.zh: 我把树皮咬成软絮给她。
lines.en: I chew bark into soft fluff for her.

lines.zh: 两串小脚印，一起上了树。
lines.en: Two little trails of prints climb the tree.
I take a sapling and head for open ground.

lines.zh: 这棵树苗，我找个好地方种。
lines.en: This sapling needs a good spot to grow.
I dig a small hole with my paws.

lines.zh: 我把树苗插进去，再盖上土。
lines.en: I set the sapling in and cover the roots.

lines.zh: 你给的树苗，我记着位置。
lines.en: I remember exactly where you gave me that.
This one goes beside the water.

lines.zh: 我又捡了一根掉落的枝条。
lines.en: I pick up another fallen twig.
Carrying a sapling slows my running.

lines.zh: 我把它藏起来，明天再种。
lines.en: I stash it and plant it tomorrow.
The tree I plant will grow very tall.

lines.zh: 树上有颗榛子，我看见了。
lines.en: I spot a hazelnut up in the tree.
A hawk is circling above my head.

lines.zh: 那边有人在翻我的藏货。
lines.en: Someone over there is digging at my stash.
Something rustled in the tall grass.
I have my eye on that tree hollow.
That branch is three hops away from me.
I have picked up the scent of hazelnuts.
Something is moving around my nest.

lines.zh: 我锁定那片摇动的灌木。
lines.en: I lock onto that swaying patch of bushes.

lines.zh: 那点东西，够我吃顿早饭。
lines.en: That little thing would make my breakfast.
I flatten on the branch and stay still.
My tail sways while I measure the distance.
When it turns around, I leap.

lines.zh: 我压低身子，爪子抓紧树皮。
lines.en: I crouch and grip the bark with my claws.
One hop left; I wait a little more.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛锁住那个洞口。
lines.en: My eyes are locked on that burrow mouth.
When the wind drops, I move.

lines.zh: 它没看见我，在树枝后面。
lines.en: It cannot see me behind this branch.

lines.zh: 落点我算过了，就在枝头。
lines.en: I have worked out my landing on that branch.
This leap will not miss.

lines.zh: 我扑上去，咬住它的耳朵。
lines.en: I pounce and bite down on its ear.
All four claws rake at once.
One strike and I scramble upward.
It is ten times my size; I am unafraid.
I clamp my teeth on its tail.
I leap onto its back from behind.
My claws leave a thin red line.
I squeak loudly to bolster my nerve.
It shakes its head and flings me off.
I can manage one more swipe.
I poke my head out of the hollow tree.

lines.zh: 森林的清晨，露水还挂着。
lines.en: Forest morning, and the dew still clings.
I perch on the branch hugging my tail.
This wood has plenty of hazel trees.

lines.zh: 我先找地方藏两颗榛子。
lines.en: First I stow away a couple of hazelnuts.
A leaf shifts and I go alert at once.

lines.zh: 我从树上溜下来，落在草里。
lines.en: I slip down the trunk into the grass.
I keep a nest at the plains' edge too.

lines.zh: 冷风一吹，我的毛蓬起来。
lines.en: The cold wind puffs my fur right up.

lines.zh: 我记下了这棵最高的树。
lines.en: I have noted the tallest tree here.
Today I plan to plant one tree.
No one is bothering me, so I get to work.

lines.zh: 火星落到尾巴上，焦了一片。
lines.en: A spark lands on my tail and singes it.
I drop from a high branch, stunned.
Water closes over me and I thrash.
The blast blows me out of the hollow.
An arrow grazes the tip of my tail.

lines.zh: 魔法让我的毛都立起来。
lines.en: Magic makes every hair on me rise.
My stash is gone and I feel weak.

lines.zh: 雷劈中树，我耳朵嗡嗡响。
lines.en: Lightning hits the tree and my ears ring.
No branches below me, only falling.
